content: I can't give you tips on how to drink to get drunk without your parents noticing or how to avoid a hangover. In fact, the safer you drink the less trouble you run into and the clearer your head stays. If you really want to 'loosen up' a bit, have a glass of water or two with every drink to keep the mouth feeling fresh, snack while you're drinking, and know your limits—but that's honestly your call.
